nodes.hint_edit: Under SIOP protocols, up-front chemotherapy without a prior biopsy is standard for a typical Wilms tumour presentation, so a histology report often does not exist yet at the point of coding — that is expected, not a gap to chase.

options.label_head: Referral letter or clinical note only — no imaging report, no cytology
options.rationale: Lowest tier. Fits every set with no Imaging Report, Cytology or Histology Report, so a lone Lab Report, IHC Report or Gene report, or nothing ticked, lands here.

options.label_head: Ultrasound, CT, or MRI report — no tissue (cytology or histology) in t
options.rationale: Imaging Report ticked and no tissue of either kind, matching the label's 'no tissue (cytology or histology)'. Lab, IHC and genetics beside imaging do not change the tier.

options.label_head: Histology report from a nephrectomy, core biopsy, or intraoperative sp
options.rationale: Tissue section report, so it requires the Histology Report document. It outranks Cytology and Imaging, so a set holding Histology plus anything else routes here. IHC or genetics alone never reach this tier.

options.label_head: Fine-needle aspiration or other cytology report only — no histology re
options.rationale: Requires the Cytology document and excludes Histology Report, as the label says 'no histology report in the file'. IHC beside Cytology without Histology stays here as immunocytochemistry.

options.label_head: A specimen (cytology, or biopsy/nephrectomy) was obtained but is repor
options.rationale: States a quality finding (inadequate, non-diagnostic or uninterpretable specimen) that no document id can express. Always available, carries no tick rules.

nodes.hint_was: Pick the highest tier of evidence genuinely in the file. Under SIOP protocols, up-front chemotherapy without a prior biopsy is standard for a typical Wilms tumour presentation, so a histology report often does not exist yet at the point of coding — that is expected, not a gap to chase.
